say:1:1421813001:1.text: Wait, what? The potion withered the mushrooms!
say:1:1421813001:1.source_cn: 使用了速生魔药后，巨蕈竟然枯萎了！

say:2:1421813002:1.text: And what's going on with those mushroom sprites? They just suddenly charged at us...
say:2:1421813002:1.source_cn: 还有那些突然冒出来攻击我们的菇灵，这究竟是怎么回事……

say:4:1421813003:1.text: It's because you've disrupted the ecosystem here and destroyed their habitat!
say:4:1421813003:1.source_cn: 因为你们破坏了这里的生态！破坏了它们的家园！

say:5:1421813004:1.text: Are you all... from the surface? What do you want from us? *Whimper* Please don't hurt me...
say:5:1421813004:1.source_cn: 你们是……地表的人……你们有什么目的？呜……不要伤害我……

say:6:1421813005:1.text: Sorry, I meant no harm! I just wanted the mushrooms to grow faster!
say:6:1421813005:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我没有想伤害任何生物，我只想让它长得更快些！

say:7:1421813006:1.text: *Sob* The flowers I planted have withered too... Just look around...
say:7:1421813006:1.source_cn: 呜……我种的花也枯萎了……看看这周围……
